title: AgentIdentity
description: Who an Agent is. Protocol sdk.syberlabs.space/v1alpha1. Built on the core tuple of Turtle's TurtleIdentity (turtle-shells, crates/turtle-policy/src/grant.rs): id, root_id, parent_id, subject_binding, and adds platform, the Agent-platform convention from SyberWork AGENTS.md section 2, optionally name@revision. It is stricter than Turtle: ids carry an agt_ prefix and subject_binding names a principal (github:, google: or service:), where Turtle's root identity sets subject_binding to its own id. GAPS.md item 13 records the mapping. A root Agent has parent_id null and root_id equal to id.
